newsitem.title: UK: BA offers cargo discounts across network.
newsitem.headline: BA offers cargo discounts across network.

text.p: British Airways has attracted extra air cargo business this month with special promotional offers, Warren Tempest, BA sales manager national accounts, told Reuters.

"BA is actively promoting the North Atlantic routes with offers which give customers discounts. On some routes these average up to 30 percent if cargo moves within 48 hours of the offer being made," Tempest said adding that this is the normal notice BA receives from its customers.
Tempest said that as a result of the promotion, business has picked up in the second half of January.

The special offers which have been made across BA's world network include flights to and from North America, southern Asia including India and from Europe. Douglas Learmond --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
